name: mindraw
description: Read Mindraw Frame links as text, annotations and PNG through the App API; open project canvases.

interface.shortDescription: Read Mindraw Frame links and open project canvases.
interface.longDescription: Mindraw provides a thin Codex plugin entry for project-scoped visual canvases. It prepares the active project's MindrawCanvas directory, preserves latest-created canvas selection rules, starts a project-scoped local read-only sidebar preview by default, and supports explicit Mindraw desktop app handoff when the user asks to open the project canvas in the app.
